summary: End-to-end validation of new blog module. Backend (10/10 pytest cases passing): public GET /api/blog, /api/blog/latest, /api/blog/{slug}; admin auth (401 without token, 401 wrong token, 200 with token); full CRUD flow (POST -> GET -> PUT -> GET -> DELETE -> 404) via X-Admin-Token; regression on POST /api/leads (201, email_sent=true). Frontend (all flows passing): /blog list renders seeded featured post with title and 'Growth' tag; /blog/:slug renders markdown (headings, bold, blockquote, ordered list) with post-cta linking to /#demo; landing page shows data-testid='blog-preview-section' with seeded card at #journal and nav-link-blog routes to /blog; /admin/blog gates behind token, rejects wrong token, signs in with correct token, creates+edits+deletes posts through the UI. Post-run DB state cleaned: only the seeded 'why-word-of-mouth-converts-5x-better-than-paid-ads' post remains.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: BlogPreview.jsx imports PostCard from '@/pages/BlogListPage' which creates a page->component reverse dependency; consider extracting PostCard into a shared component under /components/blog/ for cleaner separation.

Minor: AdminBlogPage uses localStorage token client-side only; for real production, consider server-side session tokens or short-lived JWTs. Current design is acceptable for the internal admin dashboard scope.

Nit: In AdminBlogPage.jsx signIn, on error the token is removed from localStorage but 'authed' state is still false (unchanged), which is correct. However toast.error catches all errors including network — could differentiate 401 vs 5xx for better UX.
Note: server.py's require_admin returns 503 when ADMIN_TOKEN env var is empty. That is reasonable, but could log a startup warning if ADMIN_TOKEN is missing so ops notice fast.
seed_data_creation: None. Test-created posts (slug 'ai-acquisition-hub-2') were deleted after each phase. Only the pre-existing seeded post remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blog module fully working end-to-end. Use /app/backend/tests/test_blog_api.py for regression. Public endpoints: GET /api/blog, /api/blog/latest, /api/blog/{slug}. Admin endpoints require X-Admin-Token header (value in backend/.env ADMIN_TOKEN). Frontend routes: /blog, /blog/:slug, /admin/blog. Landing preview at anchor #journal auto-hides when zero published posts.
